body:
I've been digging around a lot in this code lately (don't ask why). I found that `createRouterState` is the thing that calls `retrieve` when you don't expect it to be called.

This code should (partially) explain what you're seeing:
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/4648597d14e843f75c5e9dd761af740c1c27b5c0/packages/router/src/create_router_state.ts#L22-L44

I expect `prevState` to be falsy for the first route, and that would explain why `retrieve` is called.

Any updates on this? This is causing things to break because retrieve is called when routeReuseStrategy.shouldReuseRoute returns false in this case and setFutureSnapshotsOfActivatedRoutes throws an error that breaks our route reusability in some places, forcing us to disable reusing the route in those places. routeReuseStrategy.retrieve should not be called if shouldReuseRoute returns false.

issue.title: fix(router): Only retrieve stored route when reuse strategy indicates it should reattach

issue.body:
When creating the router state, the `RouteReuseStrategy#retrieve` should
only be called when `RouteReuseStrategy#shouldAttach` returns `true`.
That is, we should only retrieve a stored route when the reuse strategy
indicates that there is one stored and that it should be reattached.

This now matches the behavior in the route activation:
https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/1d12c50f63f90c91636185b2287e31e9c0291121/packages/router/src/operators/activate_routes.ts#L170-L172

Fixes #23162

body: This will be fixed in #30263. There seems to be a bit of confusion here though around `routeReuseStrategy.shouldReuseRoute` and what that means for `routeReuseStrategy.retrieve/shouldAttach`. Please refer to @StevenLiekens's comment https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/23162#issuecomment-378612601. When `shouldReuseRoute` returns `false`, it means that the router should not reuse the currently activated route. The logic then continues to ask the `RouteReuseStrategy` if there is instead a stored route that was previously detached that should be reattached.
